subject: Platform deep-dive — executive attendance and scheduling
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@acuityhealth.com>, Mike Turner <mike.turner@acuityhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Feb 2028 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Platform deep-dive — exec attendance and scheduling

Hi Sarah / Mike —

Thanks again for the productive POC review last week. The engineering and product teams at Acuity flagged a few platform-level questions that are best handled in a focused technical deep-dive. We’d like to schedule a 60-minute session to walk through architecture, routing/fallback, and the proposed roll-out plan for the PAC integration.

One ask up-front: it would be very helpful if an executive sponsor from Acuity (CTO or SVP product) can attend the first 30 minutes to align on risk tolerance and rollout milestones. That visibility really helps us triage the follow-ups and prioritize any changes to the runbook.

Proposed 60-min blocks (all PT):
- Mon, Feb 21 — 10:00–11:00
- Tue, Feb 22 — 09:00–10:00
- Thu, Feb 24 — 13:00–14:00

Attached: redwood-architecture-deepdive-agenda.pdf (draft) and a short SOW draft (sow-draft.docx) to help frame the rollout discussion.

Please confirm whether an exec sponsor can join and which slot works best. If none of these fit, suggest two alternate windows and we’ll adjust.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference

Attachments: redwood-architecture-deepdive-agenda.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB); sow-draft.docx (DOCX, 48KB)

From: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@acuityhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Turner <mike.turner@acuityhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Platform deep-dive — exec attendance and scheduling

Hi Vivek —

Thanks — this sounds like exactly what we need. I can confirm we want the CTO (Raj Patel) to attend the first half to cover strategic impact and compliance questions. He prefers mornings (PT) next week.

Our preferred slot would be Tue, Feb 22 — 09:00–10:00 PT. If that’s still available we’ll block it on our side.

Also: can you share a Zoom link and the deck in PPTX? My security team sometimes wants the deck ahead of time.

—
Sarah Lewis
Director of Product Strategy | AcuityHealth
sarah.lewis@acuityhealth.com | +1 (650) 555-0133

Note: I’ll add our Head of Security (cc’d once the calendar is confirmed) for the architecture/retention discussion.

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Feb 2028 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Platform deep-dive — exec attendance and scheduling

Quick internal note — Raj just told Sarah he has an all-hands conflict on Feb 22 at the top of the hour but could join 09:30–10:15 if we’re able to shift. If we confirm 09:30 start we should keep the session to 45–60 minutes and call out the first 30 minutes for exco discussion.

Marissa — can you tentatively hold 09:30–10:30 PT on 22nd for me and for the exec calendar? Aditya — can you prepare a short 10-slide summary focused on risk/rollback the CTO can review prior to the call? I’ll ask product to prepare the acceptance milestones slide.

Lauren
VP, Product Operations | Redwood Inference

[Internal only reply — do not send to Acuity yet]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@acuityhealth.com>, Mike Turner <mike.turner@acuityhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Feb 2028 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Platform deep-dive — exec attendance and scheduling

Sarah / Mike —

Thanks — appreciate the quick reply. Raj’s team flagged a soft conflict at 09:00, and he can join starting 09:30. We updated the plan on our side to open at 09:30 with a 45–60 minute agenda: first 30 minutes are CTO-level alignment, then 15–30 minutes for deep technical Q&A.

Confirmed slot: Tue, Feb 22 — 09:30–10:15 PT (we’ll keep it tight). I’ve created the calendar invite and Zoom room here: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=platform-deepdive — please accept when convenient.

We’ll upload a 10-slide executive summary and the revised agenda to the HubSpot agenda link by EOD Monday so Raj has something to scan in advance. For now I’ve attached an updated agenda PDF (minor edits) and included the draft SOW for context.

If anyone from Acuity wants to add additional attendees (security/legal/product), send the list and we’ll make sure to add a 10-minute Q&A at the end for compliance questions.

Thanks — looking forward.

—
Vivek
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-architecture-deepdive-agenda.pdf (updated), redwood-exec-summary.pptx (to follow), sow-draft.docx

Perfect — thanks for the flexibility. Raj and our Head of Security will join 09:30–10:15 PT on Tue 22nd. I’ve added the event on our side and invited legal to the final 10 minutes. We’ll send a short attendee list by EOD Monday.
